blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — A group of Muslim magistrates has strongly condemned the fatal ambush of a Basilan judge on Thursday, calling the attack a direct assault on judicial independence and the rule of law. In an official statement, the Philippine Muslim Judges Association (PMJA) expressed its profound sorrow over the killing of Judge Joseph Wee Sit, presiding judge of Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 in Isabela City, Basilan. “We condemn in the strongest possible terms this heinous act of violence against a member of the Judiciary,” the PMJA said. “An attack against a judge is an affront […]...
